name: shell-lsp
description: Shell-only LSP (.sh/.bash) via bash-language-server, with LSP-first enforcement hooks

enforce_search.title: Enforce LSP over text search (shell)
enforce_search.description: Redirect Grep/Glob/Bash-grep for shell code symbols to the LSP tool. Fail-open: disabled only when set to false. (Boolean, Default: true)

enforce_read_gate.title: Progressive read gate (shell)
enforce_read_gate.description: Require an LSP navigation call before reading many shell files (warmup -> surgical mode). Creates per-project state; fail-closed: active only when explicitly true. (Boolean, Default: true)
